_about: Caption presets for capfix_runs.py: band (fraction of the height) and capfix flags per caption style. --preset NAME picks one; --channel NAME picks the preset whose match list holds that uploader or show. Tune a new style on one chunk, then add it here with a note of the clip it was tuned on.

bold-caps.note: Big white upper-case podcast captions with black marks, one or two lines at 0.55-0.76 of the height. Add your channel names to "match".

glow-lowercase.note: Lower-case glow captions (white, amber yellow, green), one line at 0.56-0.65; amber yellow reads as skin unless --skin-bmin/--vivid-gmin are set. Upscale a 720p source to 1080x1920 first. Add your channel names to "match".

karaoke-rim.note: Karaoke captions inside a blue rim at 0.76-0.85; run in ~150-frame chunks. Add your channel names to "match".

no_capfix.grey-upcoming-karaoke: Karaoke with grey upcoming words on white shirts: capfix can't key them. Redraw the captions with scripts/caption_states.swift.
